author: Kid Bunka / project contributors
origin: Original clean geometric glyph recipes, independently constructed; no font/ROM raster inputs and no transformations of the six existing display alphabets.

styles.name: CLEAR MONO
styles.description: Open humanist mono; double-storey a, flagged 1 and hooked l.

styles.name: STUDIO SANS
styles.description: Rounded studio sans; large counters, double-storey a/g, restrained terminals.

styles.name: COMPACT GRID
styles.description: Narrow square grid; tall x-height, open 4 and compact shoulders.

styles.name: SOFT PIXEL
styles.description: Soft octagonal bowls; single-storey a/g and low rounded shoulders.

styles.name: ISO TERMINAL
styles.description: Technical chamfers; flat-topped A, straight-sided lowercase and crossbar 7.

styles.name: WIDE SCREEN
styles.description: Extended low-profile alphabet; wide apertures and single-storey a.

styles.name: PAPER TYPE
styles.description: Original small slab-serif; bracket-free feet, double-storey a/g.

styles.name: LCD CLEAN
styles.description: Continuous rectangular digital alphabet; unbroken stems, single-storey a.

styles.name: RAIL MONO
styles.description: Tall technical mono; high x-height, rising R leg and offset terminals.

styles.name: NIGHT EDITOR
styles.description: Medium upright stems with open bowls; high x-height and single-storey a.
